assumptions: USD million; fictional Rain Finch Hospital. Toy full-year financial and operating report. Net contractual consideration recognized for services, payer denials separate from credit loss; cash payments and accruals separate. No external benchmark.

evidence.text: [Activity p.12] Available beds 400 all year except 50 beds closed 60 days for renovation. Occupied inpatient bed-days120,000; inpatient discharges20,000; outpatient visits180,000. No other activity or leap-year adjustment.

[Revenue p.16] Gross inpatient charges300, contractual payer reductions90, finally denied reimbursement10. Gross outpatient charges140, contractual reductions35, final denials5. No service fee beyond these items. All net consideration invoiced.

[AR p.28] Opening gross receivables45 (already net of contractual adjustments), cash collections280, writeoffs8. No recoveries or other movements. Opening allowance10, closing allowance14; writeoffs use allowance.
[Cost p.19] Direct inpatient cost140, outpatient70, central admin40, depreciation18, all separate. Interest12, tax5. Credit loss expense from allowance bridge; no other P&L.

[Cash p.32] Operating direct+central cash payments242 (excludes depreciation, interest, tax), cash interest12, cash tax4. Capital expenditures55, equipment donation noncash10, no disposal. New debt proceeds30, principal repayment15. Opening cash25.

[PPE p.40] Opening carrying200; cash additions55 plus donated equipment10; annual depreciation18; no impairment or other movement. Donation recognized directly in restricted net assets under toy, not P&L.
[Debt note p.45] Opening gross debt130, cash borrowing30, principal repayment15. Closing total cash includes restricted equipment fund8. No other debt movement.
[KPI p.48] Occupancy uses available bed-days; length of stay occupied days/discharges. Inpatient revenue/bed-day uses net earned inpatient revenue only. FCF=CFO less cash capex; donation not cash.
[Management p.6] Uses 400×365 capacity despite closures, adds gross charges to revenue, treats donated equipment10 as both investing cash outflow and financing cash inflow.

qas.question: Available bed-days năm này sau renovation closure?
Occupancy rate đúng denominator available beds?
Average inpatient length of stay?

CFO direct từ actual cash flows?
Closing PPE carrying bao gồm equipment donated?
FCF sau cash capex theo KPI policy?
qas.answer: CFO = 280−242−12−4 = 22 triệu USD. Trừ capex tiền mặt55, không trừ thiết bị nhận tài trợ phi tiền mặt10: FCF = −33 triệu USD.

qas.question: Cash bridge theo cash receipts, investments, financing?
qas.answer: CFO = 280−242−12−4 = 22 triệu USD; closing total cash = 25+22−55+30−15 = 7 triệu USD. Note ghi tiền hạn chế8, suy ra tiền không hạn chế −1 nếu cả hai số chính xác. Đây là bất nhất cần rà soát, không tự tạo nguồn tài trợ.

qas.question: Có nên tính donated equipment10 vào cash flow để giải thích restricted cash vượt total?
qas.answer: Không. Donation phi tiền và không thay total cash. Cần reconcile balance/cash note hoặc missing flow; không tự thêm 10 cash.

qas.question: Có chứng minh cải thiện chất lượng điều trị từ occupancy 83,9% và length of stay6?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu acuity, outcomes, baseline và causal evidence; đây chỉ activity/utilization measures.
